transcript: Speaker A (Woman): Hello sir, my husband is not available right now. Can I take a message? I'll ask him to call you back. Speaker B (Man): तुमने इतनी अच्छी इंग्लिश कहाँ से सीखी? [Where did you learn such good English?] Speaker A: जब तुम ऑफिस में होते हो तब मैं English Seekho ऐप पर रोज़ 10 मिनट प्रैक्टिस करती हूँ। और बहुत ही आसानी से मुझे मेरी लैंग्वेज में सब कुछ सिखा देता है। [When you are in the office, I practice for 10 minutes daily on the English Seekho app. And very easily it teaches me everything in my language.] Speaker B: लेकिन यूज़ करने में खर्चा कितना होगा? Then download the English Seekho app today. If you also want to improve your English, download the English Seekho app now. Here you get an English Seekho coach who is available for you 24 hours. No matter how many mistakes you make, they will never judge you. So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app now.] Speaker B: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority or brand, is for educational purposes, and results may vary based on individual effort.]
summary: A woman surprises her husband with her fluent English, attributing her progress to practicing 10 minutes daily on the English Seekho app. She highlights its low cost and 24/7 non-judgmental AI coach, urging viewers to download the app.
